'''Neelir''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who was a patron of the [[Thirsty Bantha]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in [[Mos Entha/Legends|Mos Entha]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] around the time of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
